title: kith-chat: read receipt — update readAt and emit
description:
What: When Message/set update sets readAt, additionally enqueue a Peer/receipt to the original sender's mailbox (only for incoming messages where sender != 'self').

This is an additional step layered on top of KITH-e9c (Message/set update). Implement as logic within the Message/set update handler.

Algorithm (after readAt is stored, within same handler as KITH-e9c):
1. After store.messages().update_read_at(id, unix_ts)? succeeds:
2. Load message: store.messages().get(id)?
3. If message.sender_id == 'self': skip (no receipt to send for owner's own outgoing messages).
4. If message.sender_id is a contact ID:
   a. Look up contact: store.contacts().get_by_peer_user_id(sender_tailscale_user_id)? OR store.contacts().get(contact_id)?
   b. If contact found and not blocked: store.outbox().enqueue_receipt(msg_id, peer_user_id, peer_mailbox_host, 'read', read_at_unix, now_unix)?
   c. If contact not found or blocked: skip silently (cannot send receipt to unknown/blocked peer).
5. State change is already emitted by update_read_at (store layer handles EventSource broadcast).

Defensive programming rules:
- Do NOT send receipt if sender_id == 'self' (would send to ourselves).
- Do NOT panic if contact lookup fails (just skip receipt — delivery best-effort).
- Receipt enqueue is outbox-based, so it will be retried by the peer delivery worker.
- All of this is within the same store lock guard as update_read_at.
- KithError from receipt enqueue → log warning, do not fail the Message/set response (read was successful even if receipt can't be queued).

Implementation note: OutboxStore.enqueue_receipt may need to be added to kith-store if only Peer/deliver-style enqueue exists. Check whether outbox supports 'receipt' entries or just 'deliver' entries. If not, add enqueue_receipt that stores the Peer/receipt method call.

Agent team:
- Agent R: Read kith-store/src/outbox.rs (enqueue signature), kith-store/src/contact.rs (get_by_peer_user_id), kith-core/src/message.rs (Message struct sender_id field). Determine if OutboxStore needs extension for receipt enqueuing.
- Agent I: Add receipt enqueue logic to Message/set update handler (KITH-e9c handler). If OutboxStore.enqueue_receipt doesn't exist, add it to kith-store first.
- Agent T: Test that after Message/set update sets readAt on an incoming message, an outbox entry exists for the receipt. Oracle: outbox entry has correct peer_user_id and message_id.
- Agent V: cargo test -p kith-chat && cargo test -p kith-store && clippy && fmt.

Tests:
- Set readAt on incoming message → outbox has receipt entry for original sender
- Set readAt on outgoing message (sender_id='self') → no outbox receipt entry
- Set readAt when sender contact is blocked → no outbox receipt entry (silent skip)
